summary: Stocks ended a volatile session lower for a fourth straight day but well off the lows, as late short-covering trimmed losses ahead of the long weekend.

detail.laggards: Autos, media, metals, FMCG; Bajaj Auto, Maruti, Shriram Finance
detail.tone: A late recovery pulled the Sensex about 600 pts off its low and the Nifty back above 22,400, but the trend stays weak heading into the three-day break.

top.title: Autos end 3% lower on sales disappointment
top.line: Bajaj Auto and Maruti were the top Nifty losers despite strong industry volumes
more: Nifty Auto fell about 3% at the close after a 4% intraday drop
Shriram Finance was also among the biggest losers
Media, metal and FMCG were the other weakest sectors

top.title: Rate-hike worries frame Monday's reopen
top.line: Firm energy prices, bond yield volatility and rate-hike fears drove a fourth day of losses
more: The RBI MPC meets Oct 5–7; the decision is due Oct 7
Markets are shut Friday for Gandhi Jayanti

top.title: IT stands out as the only bright spot
top.line: Nifty IT was the best sector, helped by easing US rate-hike bets and Q2 positioning
more: Mphasis, Coforge and Infosys led the morning gains
Tech Mahindra board meets Oct 15 on Q2 results and a bonus
